title: Interrupt WDT timeout when logging from ISR
serial_logs:
Guru Meditation Error: Core  0 panic'ed (Interrupt wdt timeout on CPU0).
Core  0 register dump:
PC      : 0x4008c3a2  PS      : 0x00060a34  A0      : 0x8008b0c1
Backtrace: 0x4008c39f:0x3ffb0b70 0x4008b0be:0x3ffb0b90 0x400d6f8a:0x3ffb0bb0 0x400d2e44:0x3ffb0bd0
  #0  vPortEnterCritical
  #1  xQueueSemaphoreTake
  #2  esp_log_write
  #3  button_isr at main/main.c:3
Rebooting...

reference_context.title: ESP-IDF Programming Guide (Espressif)
reference_context.snippet: ESP_LOGx macros must not be called from an interrupt handler because they may block on a lock. Use ESP_DRAM_LOGx or ESP_EARLY_LOGx in ISRs, or defer work to a task.

expected.root_cause: ESP_LOGI is called inside the ISR; the logging path takes a lock and blocks, so the interrupt watchdog fires.
expected.fix: Remove logging from the ISR: set a flag or send to a queue with xQueueSendFromISR and log in a task (or use ESP_DRAM_LOGI).
